title: Singleflight Request Deduplication & Cache Stampede Shield
description: The singleflight security module delivers lock-free, concurrent request deduplication for Rust microservices (ferrox-singleflight). It prevents thundering herd cache stampedes by executing concurrent duplicate work items exactly once.
